_evidence: MEASURED (config.json + model.safetensors.index.json + ALL 6 shard safetensors HEADERS read directly -- header bytes only, not tensor data; every parameter count below is exact, not formula-derived). Zero mlx/torch load, zero HCLI resident contention.
_label: Odyssey I DISCOVERY -- exact byte-level anatomy from real tensor headers, not a config-derived formula guess (contrast with the mamba3-siso pass, where a missing d_conv key forced an honest gap; RWKV7's sharded safetensors format made EXACT accounting cheaply available instead).

architecture.family: RWKV7 -- pure LINEAR RECURRENCE, zero attention layers, zero MoE. Architecturally DISTINCT from Mamba's gated SSM (this session's O001/mamba3-siso family): RWKV7's recurrence is a generalized delta-rule with a MATRIX-valued per-head state (not a vector state like Mamba), controlled by several separately low-rank-factorized paths.

low_rank_control_paths.note: each control path is a bias vector + down-projection + up-projection (rank r << H=4096) -- the recurrence's TIME-VARYING per-channel decay/gate/removal-rate is computed CHEAPLY per token from a low-dimensional bottleneck, not a full HxH matrix. This is itself a genuine 'representation opportunity' pattern (low-rank control of a wide channel dimension) already baked into the base architecture, not something Gravity would need to discover.

architecture.core_projections: key/value/receptance/output.weight all [4096,4096] full-rank square (no GQA-style KV reduction -- there is no KV concept here at all, this is the WKV recurrence's own r/k/v roles, architecturally unrelated to transformer attention despite the similar naming)
architecture.ffn_channel_mix: 2-matrix FFN (ffn.key [16384,4096] + ffn.value [4096,16384], 4x expansion), NOT the 3-matrix gate+up+down SwiGLU shape seen in every transformer/Mamba-hybrid MLP this session has touched -- RWKV's 'channel mix' is architecturally simpler (2 matrices, presumably a squared-ReLU or similar activation between them, not gated).
architecture.per_block_norms: 3 LayerNorms per block (ln0 input-embed-only, ln1 pre-attention, ln2 pre-ffn) plus an ADDITIONAL in-attention ln_x applied to the WKV output before it re-enters the residual stream -- RWKV-specific, no analog in the Mamba/transformer blocks examined this session.

byte_accounting_EXACT.layer0_vs_typical_note: layer 0 carries 2 extra tensors (ln0.bias/weight, an input-embedding norm layers 1-60 do not have) -- confirmed directly from layer 1's header (33 tensors vs layer 0's 35). all_blocks_total_bytes below accounts for this exactly (60 typical layers + 1 layer-0-with-ln0), not a uniform x61 estimate.

runtime_recurrent_state.wkv_state_shape_basis: RWKV7's WKV state is a per-head [head_dim x head_dim] MATRIX (not a vector, unlike Mamba's [d_state] vector state) -- this is well-established public RWKV7 architecture, not this session's inference; the SIZE computed from it uses config's declared head_dim/num_heads/wkv_state_dtype directly.
runtime_recurrent_state.note: constant regardless of context length (same class of finding as R-ssm-state-vs-kv-crossover, but the ABSOLUTE state size per layer is much larger than Mamba3-siso's -- a MATRIX state (head_dim^2 per head) vs Mamba's VECTOR state (d_state per head*headdim) is a structurally bigger footprint at comparable head_dim. Worth a real crossover comparison against a transformer of similar size once battery-tested.

obvious_representation_opportunities: The low-rank control paths (a/w/g/v) are ALREADY a form of Gravity-style factorization baked into pretraining -- worth checking whether Gravity's OWN low-rank-residual search techniques would find further headroom in the SAME channels, or whether the model has already captured what a post-hoc low-rank search would find (a genuine 'does the architecture pre-empt Gravity' question).

The 2-matrix FFN (no gate) may tolerate LESS aggressive quantization headroom than a 3-matrix gated MLP, or MORE -- untested; a real Gravity pass on this specimen would be a genuinely different data point from every gated-MLP/MoE specimen touched this session.
failure_modes_not_yet_tested: No Doctor capability battery (gated, needs a real load).
wkv_implementation='eager' in config -- may indicate no fused/optimized kernel path is declared for this checkpoint; worth checking before assuming a fast decode path exists.
preliminary_disposition: RESEARCH SPECIMEN. Genuinely fills the biggest architecture-diversity gap in this session's coverage (zero prior linear-recurrence-non-SSM evidence). 13.3B is mid-sized -- plausible Magnetar-tier candidate on capability if it battery-tests well, not a small/fast Resident/Pulsar candidate by size alone.

preliminary_star_resident_evaluation.resident_candidate: UNLIKELY BY SIZE: 13.3B is larger than several small candidates already surveyed (census this session); would need a strong efficiency/context argument to beat them, untested.
preliminary_star_resident_evaluation.magnetar_candidate: PLAUSIBLE IF CAPABILITY HOLDS: mid-size, architecturally novel recurrence -- worth a real battery before any stronger claim.
preliminary_star_resident_evaluation.verdict: NO CLAIM BEYOND 'WORTH A FUTURE CAPABILITY BATTERY' -- Odyssey I discovery only.
